blocks.text: Your building access card is ready. The building office has set it up for the lobby turnstiles and for the door to our suite, and the security desk in the lobby will hand it to you on your first morning in, once they have seen photo identification. You do not need to arrange anything with them beforehand.

One point worth knowing: as I understand it, the building now switches off cards that go unused for an extended period. If yours stops working after a stretch at home, the same desk can reactivate it, and there is no need to request a replacement through us.
